details: FIeld Shift is an AI-powered smart agriculture platform that transforms NASA Earth observation data into actionable farming insights. By integrating satellite-based soil moisture, vegetation health, temperature, and rainfall information, it helps farmers make smarter decisions about irrigation, crop selection, and climate adaptation. Through interactive satellite mapping, 3D digital farm simulations, climate scenario forecasting, and a bilingual AI farming assistant, Field Shift aims to empower smallholder farmers, reduce agricultural risks, improve productivity, and promote sustainable farming in Bangladesh.
